name: American Neurological Association 151st Annual Meeting
description: The American Neurological Association holds its 151st annual meeting in San Diego, California, from October 17 to 20, 2026. The program covers clinical and translational neurology research through platform sessions, posters, and late breaking science.

name: American Neurological Association 152nd Annual Meeting
description: The American Neurological Association will hold its 152nd annual meeting in Chicago, Illinois, from September 18 to 21, 2027, with an opening symposium on September 18. Abstract submission, registration, and travel award information had not yet been published as of September 2026.

sources.note: Direct fetch confirmed the 152nd annual meeting dates (September 18-21, 2027), Chicago IL location, and that it is listed under the 'Magnificent Mile' area; no deadlines listed.

notes: Only the meeting dates and city are published for 2027; the source page names the venue area as 'The Magnificent Mile,' which is a Chicago hotel and shopping district rather than a specific confirmed hotel name, so venue is left null pending a specific hotel name. No abstract, registration, or travel award deadlines have been published yet; the prior (2026) edition's schedule is provided for reference only and none of its dates should be read as estimates for 2027.
